scientific_integrity: The high-noise global geometry follows by Gaussian conditioning, a uniform matrix-resolvent bound, and strict convexity; finite-noise reflection breaking follows from an exact comparison. No experimental enumeration is used as a proof of a universal statement.
scientific_limitations: No full finite-noise optimizer classification; critical correlation equality has multiple leading maximizers; positive-definite fixed equicorrelated two-query errors; Gaussian linear target and nonnegative cross-covariance with a unique positive maximum and a zero; historical priority provisional.
title: A universal one-half noise-correlation transition in two-query Gaussian quadrature
